Classes & Workshops
JOIN OUR ACTING CLASSES IN HONG KONG
STORYTELLING • IMPROV • SCRIPT WORK
Join actress, director, playwright and acting coach
Nicole Garbellini
for a series of practical, engaging acting classes designed to build confidence, creativity and authentic performance.
Fresh from developing and producing her original play
Unspoken: Permission Not Granted
in Riyadh, Nicole returns to Hong Kong with a renewed focus on the craft that sits at the heart of every great performance:
Storytelling.
Whether you’re completely new to acting or looking to deepen your skills, these classes will help you:
Develop confidence on stage and in everyday life
Strengthen creativity and spontaneity through improvisation
Explore character and scene work through scripts
Improve listening, communication and collaboration
Connect with a supportive community of actors and storytellers
CLASS DETAILS
When: July 6, 8, 13, 15 & 16
Time: 7:00 PM – 9:00 PM
Where: Visual Arts Centre, Hong Kong Park
Class fee: HKD 300 per class
Special offer: Book all 5 classes for HKD 1,250
WHO IS THIS FOR?
Complete beginners
Aspiring actors
Experienced performers looking to refresh their skills
Anyone interested in creativity, communication and storytelling
No previous acting experience required.
ABOUT NICOLE
Nicole Garbellini is the founder and Artistic Director of Aurora Theatre. She is an actress, director, playwright and acting coach who has worked internationally across theatre, film, education and creative development.
Her work combines professional acting techniques with soft skills training, helping students become more confident, creative and connected performers.
READY TO JOIN?
Spaces are limited. Scan the QRE Code below to book your spot or find out more!
JOIN OUR CAMERA ACTING CLASSES ONLINE
The perfect opportunity to gain confidence and experience the world of screen acting- all from the comfort of your home.
Whether you want to nail your next audition or just start your on-screen presence, this course is designed to make you shine on camera.
In these classes, you will:
Learn the nuances of acting specifically for the camera
Dive deep into character work and bring your roles to life
Perfect your self-taping technique for professional auditions
Learn how to create professional quality self-tapes for auditions and projects.
Email us at info@auroratheatrehk.com to book your spot and for any other information.
We are looking forward to getting started with you!
***Our classes are non-refundable and non-transferable
[/vc_column_text]
In 2016 we presented the children workshop and performance of Shake, Shake, Shakespeare! in collaboration with local publishing company Paddifield. The workshops were presented twice, and the final performance was part of Hong Kong Bookfair 2016.
In 2017, we collaborated with I AM for Love Pings, a spicy and sexy comedy written by Kate March and directed by Nicole Garbellini.
The play was presented in Singapore and Hong Kong.
Our 2018 starts with a kick, as we are helping out local charity The Rock Foundation to produce and present their talent show, Our Life Together: Black & White. Like every year, the charity showcases the talent of its students and volunteers, together with local actors and performers.
